findings.issue: Team cookie name, size limit and parsing are re-implemented in the layout's client script instead of importing the server module; the client copy skips normaliseTeam's validation/cap/dedupe, so the two implementations have drifted.
findings.suggestion: Astro bundles <script> tags — import { TEAM_COOKIE, MAX_TEAM_SIZE, normaliseTeam } from '../lib/team' in the script and keep one source of truth.

findings.issue: Feature-specific client behaviour (team add/remove click handling) lives in the global layout, so every page ships it and removing the Team feature leaves dead code in Base.astro.
findings.suggestion: Move the click handler into a small TeamControls.astro (or a shared client module) imported only by the pages that render team buttons.

findings.issue: getTeamMembers and getTypeCoverage are Team-feature concerns living in the shared Pokédex data module; removing or reshaping Team means editing the general lib.
findings.suggestion: Move them into lib/team.ts (or a lib/team-data.ts) so feature code stays with the feature.

findings.issue: The fetch → DOMParser → swap-subtree → popstate pattern is hand-rolled here and again in MovesSection.astro:150-190 with diverging edge-case handling (title, focus, popstate reload).
findings.suggestion: Extract one client helper (e.g. lib/partial-swap.ts) used by both scripts.

findings.issue: The detail-page scaffold (encodeURIComponent name → api() → 404 status → !x ? <NotFound/> : <Base>) plus the show()/DASH helper is duplicated across the four detail pages; an Items section adds a fifth copy.
findings.suggestion: Either accept the Astro-idiomatic per-page duplication or extract a small withResource/NotFound-boundary helper and move show() into lib/pokedex.ts next to DASH.

findings.issue: getTeamMembers builds its own type-label map instead of reusing getTypeLabels, so a labeling change has two implementations in the same file.
findings.suggestion: Call getTypeLabels() (or pass labels in) like the other card producers do.

findings.issue: Route URLs are constructed inline in six templates (CardList, Evolution, MovesSection:129, pokemon/[name].astro:139,152, types/[name].astro:71), so a URL-scheme change (e.g. a base path) fans out widely.
findings.suggestion: Add tiny href helpers to lib/pokedex.ts (pokemonHref/moveHref/typeHref) and use them from templates.

findings.issue: Media URL construction imports API_BASE_URL out of lib/api.ts, the only place the base URL escapes its module; a split API/media origin or caching-policy change reaches into the data module.
findings.suggestion: Export a mediaUrl() from lib/api.ts next to api() so all origin knowledge stays in one file.

summary: This is a well-seamed small app: cards, sections, badges and the Pokémon→species mapping are centralized, so the classic hard fixes (sprite mapping, card lists, data-source changes) land in one obvious place. The real debt is the Team feature: its client logic, cookie format and constants live in the global layout instead of a feature component, and are duplicated (and already drifted) against lib/team.ts. Fix that one seam and the codebase is genuinely pleasant to edit.
